title: Certified Network Technician (CNT)
description: Ujian sertifikasi dasar: Bangun jaringan LAN, konfigurasi addressing IPv4, subnet mask, dan default gateway. Buktikan koneksi 100% tanpa packet loss.

title: Certified Routing & Switching Specialist
description: Ujian sertifikasi switching & routing: Terapkan segmentasi VLAN (10 & 20), port trunking, dan inter-VLAN routing menggunakan Router-on-a-stick.

title: Certified Enterprise Infrastructure Architect
description: Ujian infrastruktur enterprise: Bangun jaringan multi-router dengan dynamic routing OSPF Area 0, DHCP Server otomatis, dan DNS Server terpusat.

title: Certified Network Security Specialist
description: Ujian keamanan jaringan tingkat lanjut: Amankan topologi perimeter dengan Firewall, konfigurasikan Extended ACL, dan aktifkan Switch Port Security.

title: Grandmaster Network Architect (Capstone)
description: Ujian praktisi tingkat tertinggi: Rancang bangun arsitektur enterprise skala penuh mencakup Multi-Area OSPF, DMZ Firewall, Multi-VLAN Trunking, dan Wireless Infrastructure.
